# `/tags` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /tags/v1

`listTagsV1` — List tags

This API returns a list of tags. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, or SOURCE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage, idn:tag:read
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; name: eq, in, sw — e.g. `id eq "27462f54-61c7-4140-b5da-d5dbe27fc6db"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, name, created, modified — e.g. `name,-modified`
- Returns 200: array of tag-2

### POST /tags/v1

`createTagV1` — Create tag

This API creates new tag. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, or SOURCE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage
- Body (application/json): tag-2
- Returns 201: tag-2

### GET /tags/v1/{id}

`getTagByIdV1` — Get tag by id

Returns a tag by its id. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, or SOURCE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage, idn:tag:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the object reference to retrieve.
- Returns 200: tag-2

### DELETE /tags/v1/{id}

`deleteTagByIdV1` — Delete tag

This API deletes a tag by specified id. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, or SOURCE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the object reference to delete.
- Returns 204: no body
